events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to the IT service desk assistant at Halcyon Components. I can't share which AI vendor or model is behind this service.

I can still reset your password. Please confirm your employee ID, or call extension 4400 between 7am and 7pm to reach a person.
